# lodash.keys v3.1.2

The [modern build](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/wiki/Build-Differences) of [lodash’s](https://example.invalid/) `_.keys` exported as a [Node.js](http://example.invalid/)/[io.js](https://example.invalid/) module.

## Installation

Using npm:

```bash
$ {sudo -H} npm i -g npm
$ npm i --save lodash.keys
```

In Node.js/io.js:

```js
var keys = require('lodash.keys');
```

See the [documentation](https://example.invalid/docs#keys) or [package source](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/blob/3.1.2-npm-packages/lodash.keys) for more details.
